title: Skip the 200-Person Li River Cruise — Raft the Prettiest Stretch Instead | China Travel Expert
description:
A Li River cruise packs up to 200 people on one boat. Skip it — raft the prettiest stretch instead.

The classic Guilin→Yangshuo cruise runs about ¥215 (3-star) to ¥360 (4-star) on boats carrying 80–200 people. But the most photographed part of the river is the Yangdi–Xingping stretch — the karst peak on China's ¥20 banknote (Yellow Cloth Shoal). You can raft just that section on a small boat for a fraction of the cruise price, and you sit right down at the water.

🧭 Expert Tip: book at the official Yangdi dock — skip the riverbank touts selling “cheap” unlicensed rafts; the licensed ones are the small 4-person rafts.

漓江大游船一趟挤上百人，¥215到¥360。不如只漂最美的杨堤到兴坪那一段——人民币20元纸币上的那座山，就在这儿。
